name: Cat–Cow
summary: On hands and knees, alternate rounding and arching the spine with the breath.
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Breathe out to round the spine, tail under, head heavy.
Breathe in to lengthen through to a gentle arch, chest forward.

layers.title: With the breath
layers.text: Out to round, in to arch.

layers.title: One section at a time
layers.text: Start at the tail and let the wave travel to the head.

layers.title: Add a sway
layers.text: Circle the ribs round to one side and back.

cues:
Move one bone at a time.
Push the floor away as you round.
Shoulders away from the ears as you arch.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Fists or forearms for sore wrists
